outcome_taxonomy.compatible: All deterministic assertions for a supported or fail-closed contract matched.
outcome_taxonomy.behavior_drift: A deterministic assertion no longer matches the pinned expected behavior.
outcome_taxonomy.unsupported: The case intentionally reaches a known semantic boundary Codex Scope does not claim to resolve.
outcome_taxonomy.unresolved: Known missing or conditional inputs intentionally prevent a final compatibility claim.
outcome_taxonomy.tool_error: The conformance harness or fixture failed before a semantic result could be evaluated.

rules.description: CODEX_HOME selects the Codex home used for global instruction and user-config discovery.
rules.expected_behavior: An explicit CODEX_HOME environment value is used instead of ~/.codex.
rules.supported_boundary: Codex Scope models CODEX_HOME and its explicit --codex-home inspection override.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Home-directory discovery beyond CODEX_HOME and platform-specific environment policy is not inferred.

rules.description: Global AGENTS.override.md has precedence over global AGENTS.md when non-empty.
rules.expected_behavior: The first non-empty global candidate in override/base order is active and the lower candidate is ignored.
rules.supported_boundary: Readable local files under the supplied Codex home.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Transient read errors and host-managed instruction providers are outside the deterministic local-file model.

rules.description: Global AGENTS.md is active when no higher-precedence non-empty global override is selected.
rules.expected_behavior: AGENTS.md is active as the global instruction source.
rules.supported_boundary: Readable AGENTS.md under supplied Codex home.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Host-provided remote/account instruction sources are not modeled.

rules.description: An empty global AGENTS.override.md does not block a non-empty global AGENTS.md.
rules.expected_behavior: The empty override is ignored and the base global AGENTS.md is selected.
rules.supported_boundary: Empty means whitespace-only after decoding.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Read failures are not treated as empty.

rules.description: Project instruction discovery walks from the detected project root toward cwd.
rules.expected_behavior: One selected project instruction source per applicable directory is ordered root to cwd.
rules.supported_boundary: Filesystem hierarchy between the deterministic project root and cwd.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Runtime environment overlays and remote executor filesystems are not modeled.

rules.description: Within one project directory AGENTS.override.md is discovered before AGENTS.md.
rules.expected_behavior: The override is active and the ordinary AGENTS.md in the same directory is ignored.
rules.supported_boundary: Filename discovery precedence only; prose semantics are not compared.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Model adherence to either instruction file is outside inspection.

rules.description: Configured project_doc_fallback_filenames are considered after built-in project instruction names.
rules.expected_behavior: TEAM.md is selected when no override or AGENTS.md exists in the directory.
rules.supported_boundary: Safe plain fallback filenames supplied by config.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Path-like fallback entries and executor-specific invalid filenames are outside the V0.1 fallback parser contract.

rules.description: Project discovery chooses the first existing filename before reading content; an empty override therefore blocks same-directory lower candidates but contributes no text.
rules.expected_behavior: The empty AGENTS.override.md is ignored after selection and AGENTS.md is also ignored because it lost discovery precedence.
rules.supported_boundary: Pinned to current openai/codex implementation evidence where metadata discovery precedes content filtering.
rules.unsupported_boundary: If upstream changes discovery to skip empty project candidates before filename selection, this rule must become behavior_drift and be updated.

rules.description: project_doc_max_bytes defaults to 32768 bytes.
rules.expected_behavior: With no overriding value the project instruction byte limit is 32768.
rules.supported_boundary: Resolver-critical built-in default at the pinned evidence commit.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Future upstream defaults outside the evidence boundary must be re-verified.

rules.description: project_doc_max_bytes is a cumulative project-document budget from root toward cwd.
rules.expected_behavior: A 10-byte budget includes 9 bytes from root and only 1 byte from the child file.
rules.supported_boundary: Project-document bytes only; global user instructions are outside this project budget.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Multi-environment host contributions beyond the local filesystem resolver are not modeled.

rules.description: project_root_markers controls nearest-ancestor project-root discovery.
rules.expected_behavior: A configured .scope-root marker establishes the project root above cwd.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit local marker configuration that Codex Scope can parse deterministically.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Trust inference from repository state is not performed.

rules.description: Current upstream can include one physical AGENTS.md twice when CODEX_HOME is also project root/cwd.
rules.expected_behavior: The same path appears as both global and project active instruction sources.
rules.supported_boundary: Implementation-parity fixture for open upstream issue #34193; this is not desired behavior.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Do not preserve duplication after upstream canonical-path deduplication lands.

rules.description: Explicitly untrusted projects do not contribute project AGENTS instruction sources.
rules.expected_behavior: Global instructions may remain active, but discovered project instruction candidates are ignored and do not enter the active chain.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit trust=untrusted diagnostic input with local filesystem instruction discovery.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not infer trust from runtime UI state or repository history.

rules.description: Unknown project trust must not be converted into active project instructions.
rules.expected_behavior: Global instructions remain known, project instruction candidates are unresolved, and the instruction report remains unresolved.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit trust=unknown diagnostic state.
rules.unsupported_boundary: No runtime trust prompt or trust-state discovery is executed.

rules.description: User configuration is loaded from CODEX_HOME/config.toml.
rules.expected_behavior: The user approval_policy candidate participates in resolution.
rules.supported_boundary: Supported V0.1 config keys and safe TOML subset.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Full Codex config schema and full TOML grammar remain unsupported.

rules.description: Unix system config participates below user/project/profile/CLI layers.
rules.expected_behavior: When it is the only explicit approval source, the injected system config wins.
rules.supported_boundary: Deterministic Unix-style system path supplied by the test harness.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Windows system-config location is not claimed by V0.1.

rules.description: Trusted project .codex/config.toml participates in config resolution.
rules.expected_behavior: A trusted project approval_policy can supersede the user layer.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit trust input only.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not auto-detect trust from runtime state.

rules.description: Project config is layered root to cwd and the closest applicable project layer wins.
rules.expected_behavior: The nested app/.codex/config.toml beats the project-root .codex/config.toml.
rules.supported_boundary: Trusted local project config layers.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Managed/cloud constraints that can override or constrain results remain unresolved/unsupported.

rules.description: Selected profile file participates above user config and below project/CLI layers.
rules.expected_behavior: sandbox_mode from the selected dev profile wins over the user config when project does not override it.
rules.supported_boundary: Codex 0.134.0+ profile-v2 separate file semantics modeled as CODEX_HOME/<name>.config.toml.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Legacy [profiles.name] table selection is not modeled as current behavior.

rules.description: Known -c/--config overrides have the highest modeled local precedence.
rules.expected_behavior: CLI approval_policy=never wins over project/profile/user/system/default candidates.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicitly supplied CLI override list only.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Unseen invocation flags remain unresolved unless invocation_complete is asserted.

rules.description: For repeated CLI overrides of the same key, the later supplied value wins.
rules.expected_behavior: The second approval_policy override wins.
rules.supported_boundary: Ordering of the explicitly supplied repeated -c values.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Shell/launcher transformations outside the supplied argv are not inferred.

rules.description: Project-scoped configuration is ignored for an explicitly untrusted project.
rules.expected_behavior: The user value remains effective and the project candidate is ignored.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit trust=untrusted input.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Trust discovery and UI decisions are not performed by Codex Scope.

rules.description: Unknown project trust keeps project candidates conditional and affected values unresolved.
rules.expected_behavior: A known-so-far user winner is retained but the final approval_policy state is unresolved.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit trust=unknown diagnostic state.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not guess trust from repository contents.

rules.description: Protected machine-local keys in project config are ignored.
rules.expected_behavior: Project model_provider is ignored and the user model_provider remains effective.
rules.supported_boundary: Current documented/project-protected prefix set modeled by V0.1.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Future protected keys outside the evidence date are not inferred automatically.

rules.description: Parsed config keys outside the modeled semantic subset are labeled unsupported rather than claimed effective.
rules.expected_behavior: reasoning_effort is visible with provenance but state=unsupported.
rules.supported_boundary: Safe parsing/provenance can exceed semantic support.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not claim semantic validation for arbitrary Codex config keys.

rules.description: Malformed or unsupported TOML stops configuration resolution instead of guessing.
rules.expected_behavior: The fixture raises CONFIG_PARSE_ERROR.
rules.supported_boundary: V0.1 zero-dependency safe TOML subset.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Valid TOML syntax outside the subset may be rejected even when Codex accepts it.

rules.description: CODEX_HOME is excluded from project .codex config traversal so the same config is not loaded twice.
rules.expected_behavior: The root .codex directory used as CODEX_HOME appears only as user config; a nested child project config can still win.
rules.supported_boundary: Normalized/canonical best-effort local path identity.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Filesystem identity races and exotic mount behavior are outside the deterministic boundary.

rules.description: Missing invocation/profile override completeness is preserved as unresolved.
rules.expected_behavior: Affected supported values and instruction discovery remain unresolved until invocation_complete is asserted.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit diagnostic completeness boundary.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not inspect parent launchers, aliases, or future runtime flags.

rules.description: An explicitly selected profile file that is missing fails closed.
rules.expected_behavior: The fixture raises PROFILE_NOT_FOUND rather than silently ignoring the requested profile.
rules.supported_boundary: Explicit profile-v2 file selection.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Runtime-generated or remote profile sources are not inferred.

rules.description: The historical approval_policy="untrusted" string is no longer a supported current Codex approval policy.
rules.expected_behavior: Codex Scope labels the explicit historical value unsupported instead of presenting it as a current resolved policy.
rules.supported_boundary: Evidence reflects current docs on 2026-09-22.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Historical Codex releases may have accepted this value; no version inference is performed.

rules.description: approval_policy="on-failure" is deprecated and is not claimed as current supported semantics by Codex Scope.
rules.expected_behavior: A selected profile carrying on-failure is labeled unsupported.
rules.supported_boundary: Conservative current-surface classification; provenance remains visible.
rules.unsupported_boundary: This does not claim that every historical/current binary rejects the deprecated value.

rules.description: Codex version remains unknown unless supplied or safely detected; configuration shape is not used as a version guess.
rules.expected_behavior: The compatibility matrix records tested_codex_version as unknown while pinning the tested upstream commit.
rules.supported_boundary: Static evidence commit is known; installed Codex binary version was not deterministically detected in this inspection environment.
rules.unsupported_boundary: No shell-out or heuristic version inference is allowed in the deterministic core.

rules.description: The baseline project_root_markers default is the .git marker.
rules.expected_behavior: With no configured override, project_root_markers resolves to [".git"].
rules.supported_boundary: Codex Scope models the documented local default deterministically.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Managed/cloud overrides can change effective discovery and remain outside a pure-default claim.

rules.description: The baseline project_doc_fallback_filenames default is an empty list.
rules.expected_behavior: With no configured override, project_doc_fallback_filenames resolves to [].
rules.supported_boundary: Local documented default only.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Runtime filesystem behavior for later user-configured fallback names is covered separately.

rules.description: project_doc_max_bytes accepts zero as a valid non-negative integer boundary.
rules.expected_behavior: A configured value of 0 is preserved exactly and resolves without coercion.
rules.supported_boundary: Validation and provenance of the scalar config value.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Cross-environment instruction loading is not executed by this config-only probe.

rules.description: An explicit empty project_root_markers list disables ancestor-marker discovery for the modeled local resolver.
rules.expected_behavior: With project_root_markers=[], the modeled project root is the current working directory.
rules.supported_boundary: Deterministic local path discovery with an explicit empty list.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Managed discovery inputs can override local values and are classified separately.

rules.description: project_root_markers must be an array of strings.
rules.expected_behavior: A string-valued project_root_markers override is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE.
rules.supported_boundary: Type validation before project-root discovery.
rules.unsupported_boundary: No heuristic coercion from a scalar to an array is attempted.

rules.description: project_doc_fallback_filenames must be an array of strings.
rules.expected_behavior: A scalar fallback-filename value is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE.
rules.supported_boundary: Type validation of the documented local key.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Filename path-safety semantics are tracked separately from this shape check.

rules.description: Detected managed configuration prevents local-layer resolution from being reported with false certainty.
rules.expected_behavior: When a managed requirements file is present, locally resolved approval_policy is retained as known-so-far but its state becomes unresolved.
rules.supported_boundary: Fail-closed observability for detected managed files.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not interpret enterprise/MDM requirements semantics.

rules.description: approval_policy="on-request" is a supported baseline string policy.
rules.expected_behavior: The exact string "on-request" resolves as supported without coercion.
rules.supported_boundary: Recognition/provenance of the policy value.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Runtime approval prompting is not executed by the inspector.

rules.description: approval_policy="never" is a supported baseline string policy.
rules.expected_behavior: The exact string "never" resolves as supported when selected by the profile.
rules.supported_boundary: Recognition/provenance of the policy value.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Runtime approval behavior is not executed by the inspector.

rules.description: Unknown approval_policy strings are rejected rather than treated as a known current policy.
rules.expected_behavior: An undocumented string policy fails with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE.
rules.supported_boundary: Fail-closed validation of string policy values.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Structured granular approval-policy objects are tracked as unsupported rather than interpreted.

rules.description: sandbox_mode="read-only" is a recognized baseline mode.
rules.expected_behavior: The exact string "read-only" resolves as supported.
rules.supported_boundary: Recognition/provenance of the sandbox mode.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope does not execute or simulate the sandbox.

rules.description: sandbox_mode="workspace-write" is a recognized baseline mode.
rules.expected_behavior: The exact string "workspace-write" resolves as supported.
rules.supported_boundary: Recognition/provenance of the sandbox mode.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Filesystem permission enforcement is not executed by the inspector.

rules.description: sandbox_mode="danger-full-access" is a recognized baseline mode.
rules.expected_behavior: The exact string "danger-full-access" resolves as supported.
rules.supported_boundary: Recognition/provenance of the sandbox mode.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Codex Scope never turns this value into actual unrestricted execution.

rules.description: Unknown sandbox_mode strings are rejected.
rules.expected_behavior: An undocumented sandbox mode fails with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE.
rules.supported_boundary: Fail-closed validation of the documented enum.
rules.unsupported_boundary: No sandbox behavior is inferred for unknown values.

rules.description: The modeled model key requires a string value.
rules.expected_behavior: A string model identifier is preserved with resolved provenance.
rules.supported_boundary: Shape/provenance only; no model availability or capability lookup.
rules.unsupported_boundary: The inspector does not contact a model catalog or hosted service.

rules.description: A non-string model value is rejected by the modeled semantic subset.
rules.expected_behavior: An array-valued model fails with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE.
rules.supported_boundary: Deterministic type validation.
rules.unsupported_boundary: No coercion or remote model-catalog lookup is attempted.

rules.description: A non-string model_provider value is rejected by the modeled semantic subset.
rules.expected_behavior: A numeric model_provider fails with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE.
rules.supported_boundary: Deterministic type validation of the user-level scalar.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Provider execution, authentication, and remote discovery are not performed.

rules.description: project_doc_max_bytes rejects negative integers.
rules.expected_behavior: A value of -1 fails with UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VALUE rather than being clamped or coerced.
rules.supported_boundary: Deterministic validation of the non-negative integer boundary.
rules.unsupported_boundary: Runtime multi-environment byte consumption is tracked as a separate regression boundary.
